Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Ferndale Rustic Reclaimed Pine Media TV Console Stand, 71"W, Sandstone
Colors: Sandstone
Materials: Wood
71"W x 18”D x 24”H Durable, sustainably sourced solid pine and metal Modern rustic with weathered natural finish Openings in the back make it easy to organize wires and cables Easy assembly in 15 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Made of solid reclaimed pine, this console will add a warm rustic touch to your home. Place a TV on top, gaming consoles on the lower shelf, and remote controls and cables in the four storage drawers. The natural wood grain makes each piece unique.
